title: semantic_compose_result (frozen T00, YZT-46)
description: Structured output of the bounded semantic compose phase (Phase B). Free-form prose as the sole result is forbidden: every selection is an ID into the PLAN's candidate set, and FINALIZE (Phase C, deterministic) verifies subset relations. The executor is the caller's own model (caller_llm_via_skill) until a replaceable semantic runtime takes over; this contract does not change.

context_summary.description: Optional bounded minimum-sufficient summary. It never replaces structured selection and can never add objects outside the plan.
